title: Why Should They Expand? Computational Growth, Resource Sufficiency, and Conditional Interstellar Expansion
description: CITH v7.3 research manuscript and reproducibility package. A conditional allocation model of internal computational growth and external investment, including LaTeX and PDF manuscripts, mathematical proofs, frozen synthetic inputs, numerical outputs, and executable reproduction code. This manuscript has not been published as a peer-reviewed journal article. It does not establish the prevalence of inward civilizations or indefinite physical feasibility.
